artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine is nonsensical. Characters are malformed, spacing is irregular, and it does not form recognizable words in any major language. This is a classic AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.

artifact_observations.location: Top edge of the paper block
artifact_observations.reasoning: The individual sheets of paper at the top merge into each other slightly. Instead of distinct, sharp lines separating each page, there is a 'smudged' or 'melted' appearance where the edges bleed together, lacking the crisp definition of real stacked paper.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of spine and top cover
artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometry where the spine meets the top cover is slightly soft and ill-defined. The hard edge expected from a rigid binder cover is somewhat rounded and lacks precise structural logic.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on the spine
Distinctness of individual paper sheets at the top edge
Sharpness of the geometric corners of the binder cover
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the spine. Even if the classifier identifies the object as a binder, the text quality is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, inspect the top edge of the pages: do they look like separate sheets or a solid block with fake lines? Real binders have very sharp, distinct page edges.
